Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy

That's a common worry. According to the IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, of about 3.7 crore health claims handled, 87% were paid and only 8% were rejected. As reported by IndiaMedToday, in 2023–24 insurers rejected about 11% of health claims and paid about 83%. Does the claim rejection process itself concern you?
